What happened

PropTech + AI Estate Agency SaaS
Before
Inquiries scattered across web, Gmail, Outlook, SMS
Reapit / Alto too heavy and too pricey
Second and third follow-ups rarely happened
After
14 inquiry channels unified in one inbox
AI classifies every inbound by type, urgency, property match
Automated chase sequences send from the agent's own mailbox

What happened

Independent estate agents lose leads in their own inbox. Enquiries scatter across web forms, Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, and sometimes a phone note on a Post-it. Reapit and Alto are priced and built for the corporate chains, not independents. Northbrick is our flagship build: a complete property platform with a branded public site, a multi-channel inbox unified across 14 sources, Claude-powered classification on every inbound, automated chase sequences that send from the agent's own mailbox so they still feel human, and viewings booked against the calendar with two-way sync. Multi-tenant from day one, AI-native from day one.

What we built

Branded public siteListings, search, property detail, valuation and viewing forms with JSON-LD
AI-classified unified inboxClaude Haiku tags every inbound by type, urgency, and matching property
Automated chase sequencesSend-as-mailbox follow-ups with stop conditions, so it still feels personal
Full agency adminCMS, photo manager, viewings, live chat, stats, SEO, calendar sync

After

Tutoring & Education

Independent Tutoring Business

Before
30% cut to Tutorful on every lesson booked
Monthly rent paid to a separate website builder
No ownership of student data or brand
After
0% commission, 100% of every lesson kept
£0 monthly website fees, owns the code
Full control over student experience and brand

Success Story

An independent tutor was handing 30% of every lesson booked over to Tutorful and paying a separate monthly fee to a website builder on top. We replaced both with a custom site and LMS: student login, course player, progress tracking, community discussion board, and direct payments. Same students, same lessons, but every pound stays with the tutor and the platform is hers to keep.
